verdict.rationale: Brave's docs describe a dedicated LLM Context endpoint that returns 'pre-extracted page content for your LLM — no scraping, token-budgeted' with configurable token/URL limits, going beyond simple title/snippet results and explicitly built for machine consumption in RAG/agent pipelines. missing for 10: explicit format spec (markdown vs plain text) of the extracted content, and independent/hands-on third-party validation of extraction quality/fidelity
